title: Buddha's Pork Stir Fry
description: A classic Chinese-inspired stir fry made with tender pork and a variety of vegetables, served with a sweet and tangy sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir in the sweet soy sauce.
Add the mixed greens and cook until wilted.
